channel.title: The Countertop Guide
channel.description: Air fryers and meat thermometers, read against the listing, not the hype.

item.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?
item.description: Basket-style and oven-style air fryers cook and fit counters differently. Here is what to compare before you choose, using only listing text and official references.

item.title: A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity
item.description: Capacity numbers on air fryer listings can mean different things. This checklist shows what to check before you compare sizes.

item.title: How to assess cleanup and counter-space trade-offs
item.description: Cleanup and counter space decide whether an air fryer stays out or goes back in a cabinet. Here is how to judge both from the listing and your own kitchen.

item.title: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance
item.description: Multi-function appliances promise many jobs. These questions help you check whether you need the extra functions before you buy.

item.title: What temperature should your meat thermometer confirm?
item.description: The USDA publishes minimum internal temperatures for each type of food. Here is the chart, what it does and does not tell you, and how the two thermometers on this site are described.
